Six days of blessings

Functions & Ceremonies

From the first prayer to the last dance, join us for every moment of our celebration.

21 Nov 2026 Saturday

Subh Rudra Abhishek

A sacred bathing of Lord Shiva with milk, water and flowers, to begin our celebrations with his blessings.

22 Nov 2026 Sunday

Ram Naam Kirtan

An evening of devotional singing and music, with family and friends gathered close around the lamps.

23 Nov 2026 Monday

Haldi & Mehendi

A day of turmeric, henna and laughter. Wear yellow and green, and come ready to be a little messy.

24 Nov 2026 Tuesday

Swaruchi Bhoj

A grand traditional feast, served with love. Come hungry and share a meal with the whole family.

25 Nov 2026 Wednesday

Wedding

Under the mandap and around the sacred fire, we take our seven vows. Your blessings will make the day complete.

The Wedding Day
28 Nov 2026 Saturday

Reception

A glowing evening of dinner, music and dancing to celebrate the newly married couple.
